title: Ship Sinks During SINKEX (BRoll)
description: A U.S. Navy P-8A Poseidon with Patrol Squadron 45 (VP-45) forward-deployed to Naval Air Facility Misawa, Japan observes a sink exercise (SINKEX) during exercise Valiant Shield Sept. 23, 2018. Valiant Shield is a U.S. only, biennial field training exercise (FTX) with a focus on integration of joint training in a blue-water environment among U.S. forces. This training enables real-world proficiency in sustaining joint forces through detecting, locating, tracking, and engaging units at sea, in the air, on land, and in cyberspace in response to a range of mission areas.(U.S. Air Force video by Senior Airman Dhruv Gopinath/Released)
credit: U.S. Air Force video by Senior Airman Dhruv Gopinath/Released
pass_reason: 2018 grainy FLIR-style SINKEX, low detail; one SINKEX a day (Peleliu used)
